en-US.short_description: Browse, create and extract archives on Linux. Preview supported files and edit eligible archive entries.
en-US.description:
xdzip is an open-source archive manager for Linux. Browse archives, find files and extract selected items without unpacking everything. Basic archive operations work offline.

Browse ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, CAB, ISO, UDF and other supported formats. Search, sort, navigate folders and open multiple archives in tabs or separate windows. Preview supported text and images.

Create supported archive formats and ISO9660/Joliet data images. Eligible regular single-file archives can be edited. Format and encryption support varies; opening a file in another application uses a temporary copy and does not write edits back.

Use the installed Files (Nautilus) extension to create or extract archives. Choose from ten interface languages, light and dark themes, and adjustable text sizes.

Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64, X11.
features: Browse supported archives without extracting everything.
Search, sort and navigate archive folders.
Extract selected files and folders.
Create archives and ISO data images.
Use supported encryption and split archive profiles.
Edit entries in eligible archives.
Preview supported text and images.
Open multiple archives in tabs or separate windows.
Use the installed Files (Nautilus) extension to create or extract archives.
Choose interface language, theme and text size.

zh-CN.square_tagline: 打包与解压，都简单一点。
zh-CN.short_description: 在 Linux 上浏览、创建和解压归档，预览受支持文件并编辑符合条件的条目。
zh-CN.description:
xdzip 是一款开源 Linux 压缩包管理工具。先查看包内内容，找到需要的文件，再选择性解压，无需每次解开整个压缩包。基础归档操作可离线使用。

浏览 ZIP、7z、RAR、TAR、CAB、ISO、UDF 等受支持格式，通过搜索、排序和目录导航查找文件，在多个标签页或独立窗口中打开归档，并预览受支持的文本和图片。

创建受支持的压缩包和 ISO9660/Joliet 数据镜像，编辑符合条件的普通单文件归档。不同格式的功能和加密支持有所区别；使用其他应用打开包内文件时会生成临时副本，修改不会自动写回。

通过已安装的文件（Nautilus）扩展创建和解压归档。界面支持十种语言、浅色和深色主题及字号调整。

Ubuntu 24.04，x86_64，X11。
